checks.text: Typing 1 in the field labelled "Meters" shows 3.28084 in the field labelled "Feet".
Typing 10 in the field labelled "Feet" shows 3.048 in the field labelled "Meters".
After clicking the tab "Temperature", typing 100 in "Celsius" shows 212 in "Fahrenheit"; replacing it with -40 shows -40 in "Fahrenheit".
After typing 1 in "Meters", clicking the tab "Mass" shows the empty fields "Kilograms" and "Pounds" and no field labelled "Meters".
After typing 1 in "Meters", clicking "Swap units" shows 1 in the field labelled "Feet" (now first) and 0.3048 in the field labelled "Meters".
Typing abc in "Meters" shows the text "Enter a number", leaves "Feet" empty, and the page text contains no "NaN".

Typing 1, 2 and 3 in "Meters", clicking "Save conversion" after each, shows 3 recent items, the first "3 Meters = 9.84252 Feet" and the last "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet"; clicking "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet" puts 1 in "Meters" and 3.28084 in "Feet".
Saving the values 1 to 11 in "Meters" in order keeps 10 recent items: the first "11 Meters = 36.08924 Feet", the second "10 Meters = 32.8084 Feet", the last "2 Meters = 6.56168 Feet".
Reload keeps the Recent list: after saving 1 in "Meters" and reloading, the recent item "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet" is shown.
